ayahs.arabic: كٓهيعٓصٓ
ayahs.translit: KafhayaAAaynsad

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad

ayahs.arabic: ذِكۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبۡدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
ayahs.translit: Thikru rahmati rabbika AAabdahu zakariyya

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Ith nada rabbahu nidaan khafiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When he called to his Lord a private supplication

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ ٱلۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّي وَٱشۡتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأۡسُ شَيۡبࣰ ا وَلَمۡ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi innee wahana alAAathmu minnee waishtaAAala alrrasu shayban walam akun biduAAaika rabbi shaqiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّي خِفۡتُ ٱلۡمَوَٰلِيَ مِن وَرَآءِي وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرࣰ ا فَهَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wainnee khiftu almawaliya min waraee wakanati imraatee AAaqiran fahab lee min ladunka waliyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir

ayahs.arabic: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ ءَالِ يَعۡقُوبَۖ وَٱجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Yarithunee wayarithu min ali yaAAqooba waijAAalhu rabbi radiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]

ayahs.arabic: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسۡمُهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ لَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ سَمِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Ya zakariyya inna nubashshiruka bighulamin ismuhu yahya lam najAAal lahu min qablu samiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمࣱ وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرࣰ ا وَقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِبَرِ عِتِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun wakanati imraatee AAaqiran waqad balaghtu mina alkibari AAitiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنࣱ وَقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُكَ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَكُ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala kathalika qala rabbuka huwa AAalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَل لِّيٓ ءَايَةࣰۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالࣲ سَوِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa thalatha layalin sawiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound

ayahs.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Fakharaja AAala qawmihi mina almihrabi faawha ilayhim an sabbihoo bukratan waAAashiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon

ayahs.arabic: يَٰيَحۡيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةࣲۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمَ صَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Ya yahya khuthi alkitaba biquwwatin waataynahu alhukma sabiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy

ayahs.arabic: وَحَنَانࣰ ا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةࣰۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wahananan min ladunna wazakatan wakana taqiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah

ayahs.arabic: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ وَلَمۡ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wabarran biwalidayhi walam yakun jabbaran AAasiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant

ayahs.arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡهِ يَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوۡمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُ حَيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wasalamun AAalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yubAAathu hayyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَرۡيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ أَهۡلِهَا مَكَانࣰ ا شَرۡقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Waothkur fee alkitabi maryama ithi intabathat min ahliha makanan sharqiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذَتۡ مِن دُونِهِمۡ حِجَابࣰ ا فَأَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرࣰ ا سَوِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Faittakhathat min doonihim hijaban faarsalna ilayha roohana fatamaththala laha basharan sawiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man

ayahs.arabic: قَالَتۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qalat innee aAAoothu bialrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمࣰ ا زَكِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala innama ana rasoolu rabbiki liahaba laki ghulaman zakiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy

ayahs.arabic: قَالَتۡ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمࣱ وَلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِي بَشَرࣱ وَلَمۡ أَكُ بَغِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qalat anna yakoonu lee ghulamun walam yamsasnee basharun walam aku baghiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنࣱۖ وَلِنَجۡعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّاۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرࣰ ا مَّقۡضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala kathaliki qala rabbuki huwa AAalayya hayyinun walinajAAalahu ayatan lilnnasi warahmatan minna wakana amran maqdiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed

ayahs.arabic: ۞فَحَمَلَتۡهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتۡ بِهِۦ مَكَانࣰ ا قَصِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Fahamalathu faintabathat bihi makanan qasiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place

ayahs.arabic: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلۡمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ قَالَتۡ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي مِتُّ قَبۡلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسۡيࣰ ا مَّنسِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Faajaaha almakhadu ila jithAAi alnnakhlati qalat ya laytanee mittu qabla hatha wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten

ayahs.arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحۡتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحۡزَنِي قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Fanadaha min tahtiha alla tahzanee qad jaAAala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream

ayahs.arabic: وَهُزِّيٓ إِلَيۡكِ بِجِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ تُسَٰقِطۡ عَلَيۡكِ رُطَبࣰ ا جَنِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wahuzzee ilayki bijithAAi alnnakhlati tusaqit AAalayki rutaban janiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates

ayahs.arabic: فَكُلِي وَٱشۡرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيۡنࣰ اۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡبَشَرِ أَحَدࣰ ا فَقُولِيٓ إِنِّي نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ صَوۡمࣰ ا فَلَنۡ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِنسِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Fakulee waishrabee waqarree AAaynan faimma tarayinna mina albashari ahadan faqoolee innee nathartu lilrrahmani sawman falan okallima alyawma insiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man

ayahs.arabic: فَأَتَتۡ بِهِۦ قَوۡمَهَا تَحۡمِلُهُۥۖ قَالُواْ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا فَرِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Faatat bihi qawmaha tahmiluhu qaloo ya maryamu laqad jiti shayan fariyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأُخۡتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمۡرَأَ سَوۡءࣲ وَمَا كَانَتۡ أُمُّكِ بَغِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Ya okhta haroona ma kana abooki imraa sawin wama kanat ommuki baghiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste

ayahs.arabic: فَأَشَارَتۡ إِلَيۡهِۖ قَالُواْ كَيۡفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَهۡدِ صَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Faasharat ilayhi qaloo kayfa nukallimu man kana fee almahdi sabiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِيَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala innee AAabdu Allahi ataniya alkitaba wajaAAalanee nabiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوۡصَٰنِي بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: WajaAAalanee mubarakan ayna ma kuntu waawsanee bialssalati waalzzakati ma dumtu hayyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive

ayahs.arabic: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِي وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِي جَبَّارࣰ ا شَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wabarran biwalidatee walam yajAAalnee jabbaran shaqiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوۡمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوۡمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ أُبۡعَثُ حَيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Waalssalamu AAalayya yawma wulidtu wayawma amootu wayawma obAAathu hayyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۖ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡحَقِّ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Thalika AAeesa ibnu maryama qawla alhaqqi allathee feehi yamtaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute

ayahs.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدࣲۖ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥٓۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣰ ا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.translit: Ma kana lillahi an yattakhitha min waladin subhanahu itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wainna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path

ayahs.arabic: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن مَّشۡهَدِ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.translit: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min mashhadi yawmin AAatheemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day

ayahs.arabic: أَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصِرۡ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: AsmiAA bihim waabsir yawma yatoonana lakini alththalimoona alyawma fee dalalin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحَسۡرَةِ إِذۡ قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ وَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waanthirhum yawma alhasrati ith qudiya alamru wahum fee ghaflatin wahum la yuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا وَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna nahnu narithu alarda waman AAalayha wailayna yurjaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقࣰ ا نَّبِيًّا
ayahs.translit: Waothkur fee alkitabi ibraheema innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا يَسۡمَعُ وَلَا يُبۡصِرُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنكَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.translit: Ith qala liabeehi ya abati lima taAAbudu ma la yasmaAAu wala yubsiru wala yughnee AAanka shayan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي قَدۡ جَآءَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ يَأۡتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعۡنِيٓ أَهۡدِكَ صِرَٰطࣰ ا سَوِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Ya abati innee qad jaanee mina alAAilmi ma lam yatika faittabiAAnee ahdika siratan sawiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَصِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Ya abati la taAAbudi alshshaytana inna alshshaytana kana lilrrahmani AAasiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابࣱ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيۡطَٰنِ وَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Ya abati innee akhafu an yamassaka AAathabun mina alrrahmani fatakoona lilshshyatani waliyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِي يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ لَأَرۡجُمَنَّكَۖ وَٱهۡجُرۡنِي مَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala araghibun anta AAan alihatee ya ibraheemu lain lam tantahi laarjumannaka waohjurnee maliyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَۖ سَأَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِي حَفِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Qala salamun AAalayka saastaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kana bee hafiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me

ayahs.arabic: وَأَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّي شَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: WaaAAtazilukum wama tadAAoona min dooni Allahi waadAAoo rabbee AAasa alla akoona biduAAai rabbee shaqiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۖ وَكُلࣰّ ا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Falamma iAAtazalahum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi wahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wakullan jaAAalna nabiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet

ayahs.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wawahabna lahum min rahmatina wajaAAalna lahum lisana sidqin AAaliyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخۡلَصࣰ ا وَكَانَ رَسُولࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Waothkur fee alkitabi moosa innahu kana mukhlasan wakana rasoolan nabiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet

ayahs.arabic: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنَٰهُ نَجِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wanadaynahu min janibi alttoori alaymani waqarrabnahu najiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him]

ayahs.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحۡمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wawahabna lahu min rahmatina akhahu haroona nabiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Waothkur fee alkitabi ismaAAeela innahu kana sadiqa alwaAAdi wakana rasoolan nabiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet

ayahs.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأۡمُرُ أَهۡلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرۡضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wakana yamuru ahlahu bialssalati waalzzakati wakana AAinda rabbihi mardiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِدۡرِيسَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Waothkur fee alkitabi idreesa innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet

ayahs.arabic: وَرَفَعۡنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
ayahs.translit: WarafaAAnahu makanan AAaliyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We raised him to a high station

ayahs.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحࣲ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَٱجۡتَبَيۡنَآۚ إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ خَرُّواْۤ سُجَّدࣰ اۤ وَبُكِيࣰّ ا۩
ayahs.translit: Olaika allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena min thurriyyati adama wamimman hamalna maAAa noohin wamin thurriyyati ibraheema waisraeela wamimman hadayna waijtabayna itha tutla AAalayhim ayatu alrrahmani kharroo sujjadan wabukiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping

ayahs.arabic: ۞فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ أَضَاعُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّا
ayahs.translit: Fakhalafa min baAAdihim khalfun adaAAoo alssalata waittabaAAoo alshshahawati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.translit: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona shayan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all

ayahs.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَأۡتِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Jannati AAadnin allatee waAAada alrrahmanu AAibadahu bialghaybi innahu kana waAAduhu matiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمࣰ اۖ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيهَا بُكۡرَةࣰ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan waAAashiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon

ayahs.arabic: تِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min AAibadina man kana taqiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّكَۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِينَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful

ayahs.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma faoAAbudhu waistabir liAAibadatihi hal taAAlamu lahu samiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ أُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا
ayahs.translit: Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.translit: Awala yathkuru alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min qablu walam yaku shayan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing

ayahs.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum waalshshayateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمۡ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عِتِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Thumma lananziAAanna min kulli sheeAAatin ayyuhum ashaddu AAala alrrahmani AAitiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Thumma lanahnu aAAlamu biallatheena hum awla biha siliyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمۡ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَاۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتۡمࣰ ا مَّقۡضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Wain minkum illa wariduha kana AAala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Thumma nunajjee allatheena ittaqaw wanatharu alththalimeena feeha jithiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتࣲ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَيُّ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ خَيۡرࣱ مَّقَامࣰ ا وَأَحۡسَنُ نَدِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ayyu alfareeqayni khayrun maqaman waahsanu nadiyyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ أَثَٰثࣰ ا وَرِءۡيࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wariyan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَدًّاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرࣱّ مَّكَانࣰ ا وَأَضۡعَفُ جُندࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Qul man kana fee alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona imma alAAathaba waimma alssaAAata fasayaAAlamoona man huwa sharrun makanan waadAAafu jundan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers

ayahs.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ هُدࣰ ىۗ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابࣰ ا وَخَيۡرࣱ مَّرَدًّا
ayahs.translit: Wayazeedu Allahu allatheena ihtadaw hudan waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun maraddan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse

ayahs.arabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالࣰ ا وَوَلَدًا
ayahs.translit: Afaraayta allathee kafara biayatina waqala laootayanna malan wawaladan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]

ayahs.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: AttalaAAa alghayba ami ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّاۚ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ مَدࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqoolu wanamuddu lahu mina alAAathabi maddan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively

ayahs.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأۡتِينَا فَرۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wanarithuhu ma yaqoolu wayateena fardan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لِّيَكُونُواْ لَهُمۡ عِزࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan liyakoonoo lahum AAizzan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّاۚ سَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّا
ayahs.translit: Kalla sayakfuroona biAAibadatihim wayakoonoona AAalayhim diddan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement]

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ أَزࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayateena AAala alkafireena taozzuhum azzan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Fala taAAjal AAalayhim innama naAAuddu lahum AAaddan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَفۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yawma nahshuru almuttaqeena ila alrrahmani wafdan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

ayahs.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wanasooqu almujrimeena ila jahannama wirdan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَمۡلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: La yamlikoona alshshafaAAata illa mani ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son

ayahs.arabic: لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِدࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Laqad jitum shayan iddan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: You have done an atrocious thing

ayahs.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا
ayahs.translit: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqu alardu watakhirru aljibalu haddan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

ayahs.arabic: أَن دَعَوۡاْ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: An daAAaw lilrrahmani waladan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
ayahs.translit: Wama yanbaghee lilrrahmani an yattakhitha waladan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son

ayahs.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِي ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَبۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: In kullu man fee alssamawati waalardi illa atee alrrahmani AAabdan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant

ayahs.arabic: لَّقَدۡ أَحۡصَىٰهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Laqad ahsahum waAAaddahum AAaddan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمۡ ءَاتِيهِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا
ayahs.translit: Wakulluhum ateehi yawma alqiyamati fardan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وُدࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sayajAAalu lahumu alrrahmanu wuddan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوۡمࣰ ا لُّدࣰّ ا
ayahs.translit: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqeena watunthira bihi qawman luddan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزَۢا
ayahs.translit: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasmaAAu lahum rikzan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound
